commit_boundaries: base mutation and candidate approved state commit together
embedding, invalidation and dirty hooks are post-commit
approve_promotion.failure_boundary: transaction failure rolls back base mutation and candidate state together; post-commit hook failure cannot revert approval
sequence: commit base object/provenance and candidate approval in one transaction
embed fresh base object best effort

commit_boundaries: resolution mutation commits before candidate status transaction
candidate status is a later independent commit
confirm_conflict.failure_boundary: candidate-status failure leaves the already committed resolution mutation applied
sequence: apply resolution through its independently committed mutation primitive
set candidate applied in a separate transaction

commit_boundaries: sentinel and every table chunk are separate commits
filesystem copy precedes database sentinel
failure compensates only destination
copy_notebook.failure_boundary: partial destination is removed; source and unrelated live sentinels are untouched
sequence: copy each table in configured chunks

commit_boundaries: database cleanup is atomic
filesystem deletion is post-commit
delete_source.failure_boundary: a file-delete failure cannot roll back committed database cleanup
sequence: clear source-derived KG and embeddings plus delete source in one write

commit_boundaries: target evidence, reverse index and source deprecation are atomic
merge_knowledge.failure_boundary: post-commit dirty/cache failure cannot roll back merge
sequence: merge evidence and deprecate source in one write

commit_boundaries: each migration version is stamped after its migration
recovery and seed use their existing connection commits
migration_recovery_seed.failure_boundary: startup completes these serial phases before serving requests; they bypass online mutation hooks

commit_boundaries: inherits every process_source checkpoint
parse_source.failure_boundary: inherits process_source failed-state recording and best-effort phases

commit_boundaries: status transitions are separate writes
element replacement commits before chunk/embed/extraction
chunk, embeddings, extraction and final status are later checkpoints
process_source.failure_boundary: pipeline errors record failed source state; chunk/embed/dirty hooks fail open
sequence: parse and optional in-memory element enrichment outside transaction
replace elements and source-derived state in one write

commit_boundaries: review row commits before dirty and cache side effects
set_edge_review.failure_boundary: missing relation raises; post-commit side-effect failure does not revert review
sequence: update relation review in one write

commit_boundaries: each 1000-object block is a transaction
each 1000-relation block is a transaction
partial source state is an accepted crash window
store_kg.failure_boundary: later chunks and post-commit hooks never roll back already committed chunks
sequence: embed objects and relations best effort
mark unified KG dirty and bump mutation sequence

commit_boundaries: begin, trace, answer and finish are independent short transactions
answer may exist before job finish after a crash
streaming_ask.failure_boundary: transport disconnect leaves detached worker running; explicit cancel alone sets cancellation event
sequence: begin conversation and running job transaction

commit_boundaries: row update commits before embedding/invalidation
update_knowledge.failure_boundary: embedding failure is swallowed; committed row remains and dirty/invalidation still run
